(c) Living in emergency hospitals
        No. of hospitals           :      11
        No. of refugee patients :      892

    As compared with statistics made on February 2,
1939, the number of refugees housed in camps show a
decrease from 49,779 to 42,910, the number of
refugees living in alleyways and vacant houses (not
camps) show a decrease from 5,793 to 5,750 and the
number of refugee patients in emergency hospitals
has increased from 834 to 892.

    Revised lists of (a) refugee camps together
with their present accommodation, (b) number of
refugees living in alleyways and vacant houses, and
(c) emergency hospitals for refugees together with
their accommodation are attached as appendices "A",
"B" and "C" respectively.

    During February, a new refugee camp was
established by the Shanghai Refugee Relief Associa-
tion, 93 Canton Road, on a site opposite No. 151
Tunsin Road, which has been designated No. 1 Refugee
Camp of the Shanghai Refugee Relief Association
(上海難民救濟協會第一收容所)(Bubbling Well District).
This camp has accommodation for some 7,000 persons
and commenced accommodating refugees on February 3,
1939.    The Shanghai Refugee Relief Association
has also taken over the management of the Yenping
Road Experimental Camp of the Shanghai Emergency
Relief Committee on Yenping Road, north of Connaught

(c) 居住在临时医院者
        医院数量           :      11
        难民病患人数 :      892

    与1939年2月2日统计数字相比，收容所内安置的难民人数从49,779人减少至42,910人，居住在弄堂和空置房屋（非收容所）的难民人数从5,793人减少至5,750人，而临时医院内的难民病患人数则从834人增加至892人。

    经修订的(a)难民收容所名单及其现有容纳量、(b)居住在弄堂和空置房屋的难民人数，以及(c)难民临时医院名单及其容纳量，分别作为附录“A”、“B”和“C”附后。

    二月期间，上海难民救济协会在广东路93号对面、同信路151号对面的地块上建立了一个新的难民收容所，命名为上海难民救济协会第一收容所（Bubbling Well District [静安寺区]）。该收容所可容纳约7,000人，并于1939年2月3日开始接收难民。上海难民救济协会还接管了上海急赈委员会位于康纳特路（Connaught Road）以北延平路的延平路实验收容所的管理工作，

The somewhat large decrease in the total
number of refugees in the Settlement is chiefly
due to the failure of some 5,000 refugees to enter
the new camp on Tunsin Road and other camps pre-
pared for them in the Western District when
evacuated from the old camps in February in conse-

to regain possession of their properties, and have
found accommodation elsewhere.

(c) Living in emergency hospitals
No. of hospitals : 10
No. of patients : 834

As compared with statistics made on December 31, 1938, the number of refugees housed in camps show a decrease from 49,844 to 49,779, the number of refugees living in alleyways and vacant houses (not camps) show an increase from 4,771 to 5,793 and the number of refugee patients in emergency hospitals has decreased from 937 to 834.

Revised lists of (a) refugee camps together with their present accommodation, (b) number of refugees living in alleyways and vacant houses, and (c) emergency hospitals for refugees together with their accommodation are attached as appendices "A", "B" and "C", respectively.

On January 16, 1939, the affairs of the 1st Emergency Hospital for Refugees sponsored by the Shanghai Emergency Relief Committee, 240 North Thibet Road, were handed over to the Shanghai Refugee Relief Association, 93 Canton Road, because of financial difficulties. The hospital is at present undergoing repair and the doctors and other personnel employed by the hospital, have been paid off. The refugee patients totalling approximately 120, have been removed to and accommodated at the Emergency Hospital for Refugees sponsored by the International Relief Committee, Avenue Haig (French Concession), pending the completion of repair.

1939年1月16日，由于财政困难，由上海紧急救济委员会资助、位于北西藏路240号的第一难民应急医院的事务已移交给位于广东路93号的上海难民救济协会。该医院目前正在进行修缮，医院雇用的医生及其他人员已被解聘并结清薪资。总计约120名难民病患已被转移并安置于由国际救济委员会资助、位于海格路（法租界）的难民应急医院，以待修缮完成。

D.S. Fowler reports having visited together with C.D.S,
234 between 10 a.m. and 12 noon and 3 p.m. to 7 p.m. on the
4-1-38 the following refugee camps situated at, Nos. 730, 784,
834 and 894 Boone Road, No. 639, Lane 691/9 and 11, 905-11,
920, 926-930 Haining Road.
Enquiries reveal, and in a number of instances it was
observed, that the inmates of those camps visited on leaving
the premises are searched and again on their return.
The practice adopted in checking the inmates in and
out is similar in all cases in that either an identification
tag or photo is handed in at the door by each one on leaving
and a number given in exchange. This procedure is reversed
on re-entering.

Sir,
I beg to report that on 16/8/37 no refugees entered the
Settlement, as all the boundary gates are closed.
About 1,100 families evacuated their homes in the West
Hongkew District and proceeded to other part of the Settlement.

Market, left on 16/8/37.

I am, Sir,

Date 13th August 19 37

REPORT

Subject Influx of Refugees to the International Settlement, etc.

Made by D.S.I. Shields Forwarded by J.M. Lennox of Supt.

Sir,
I beg to report that between 6 a.m. 12-8-37 and 7 p.m.
12-8-37 the following number of refugees entered the settlement
at various points in West Hongkew District.

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| Foundry - North Honan Roads | 6000 refugees |
| " North Szechze Roads | 4600 " |
| Haining - Jehol Roads | 260 " |
| North Thibet - Haining Roads | 4840 " |
| " " - Kaifeng Roads | 200 " |
| " " - Alabaster Roads | 300 " |
| Total | 16200 " |

No additional refugees in lodginghouses.

C.D.C. 221 reports that at 10.52 a.m. 12/8/37 about 500
armed soldiers of the 88th Division were marching towards Paoshan
were taking up positions in the vicinity of
Road passed the Shanghai North Railway Station.

The above C.D.C. also reports that at 12.20 p.m. 12/8/37
two Japanese subjects in foreign plain clothes, one being in
possession of a pistol and the other unarmed, were arrested by
the Railway Police on the west side of the North Railway Station
and it was not known, where they had been taken to. It was later
ascertained that these two men had returned to their homes.

The above C.D.C. further reports that at 1.05 p.m. 12/8/37
one Japanese subject was arrested by the North Railway Branch
Station of the S.C.C.P.B. and a soldier of the 88th Division
in the avenue of the North Railway Station, Chapei and it was
not known, where the Japanese was taken to (See Misc. 315/37 W.H.)

The above C.D.C. also reports that at 12.30 p.m. 12/8/37
mobilization was proclaimed in Chapei and all trains to and from
Shanghai were discontinued. At 6 p.m. 12/8/37 martial law was

（左侧手写批注：C.J.S.Z. C 3/2 S.T. 2/R 378）

先生，
谨此报告，1937年8月12日上午6时至
1937年8月12日下午7时之间，下列数量的难民
在西虹口区的各个地点进入租界。

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| 铸造厂 - 河南北路 | 6000名难民 |
| “ 四川北路 | 4600 ” |
| 海宁路 - 热河路 | 260 ” |
| 西藏北路 - 海宁路 | 4840 ” |
| “ ” - 开封路 | 200 ” |
| “ ” - 阿拉巴斯特路（Alabaster Roads，音译） | 300 ” |
| 总计 | 16200 ” |

旅馆中无新增难民。

第221号分区巡捕房（C.D.C. 221）报告称，1937年8月12日上午10时52分，约500名
第88师武装士兵正 marching towards Paoshan（向宝山行进），在
路过上海北火车站附近区域时占据阵地。

上述第221号分区巡捕房（C.D.C.）还报告称，1937年8月12日下午12时20分，
两名身穿外国便服的日本籍人士，其中一人持有手枪，另一人未携带武器，在北火车站西侧被铁路警察逮捕，不知被带往何处。后查明这两人已返回家中。

上述第221号分区巡捕房（C.D.C.）进一步报告称，1937年8月12日下午1时05分，一名日本籍人士在上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.C.C.P.B.）北火车站分巡捕房及闸北北火车站大道上的一名第88师士兵处被捕，不知该日本人被带往何处（参见杂项档案 315/37 W.H.）

上述第221号分区巡捕房（C.D.C.）还报告称，1937年8月12日下午12时30分，闸北宣布动员，所有往返上海的列车均停运。1937年8月12日下午6时，戒严令
